subject: inla.exe is crashing, problems in windows 7

messages.author: 0ffa30a50441fd58
messages.subject: inla.exe is crashing, problems in windows 7
parts:
Hi,

I am using R inla with windows 7, and my
problem is, always when inla crashes (in my situation the error message that
is returned from inla() is error number 12, newton raphson does not
converge) a windows 7 information window appears telling me "inla.exe is
crashing".
My problem with this is, only when I close this window by hand, my loop
computing inla results for several prediction days, contiues, otherwise the
function is hovering at the current loop step as the inla call of the
current step is not finished/terminated or whatever.
Is there any possibilty
either to prevent this inla.exe crashes in general or in somehow give the
inla call an argument so that this windows 7 "information window" does not appear but that in case of inla.exe crashing the current inla call is just
stopped/terminated so that my loop can continue to the next step and try the next inla call?
This problem with this windows 7 window is really annoying,
as I always need to stop it by hand and cannot just run the whole loop
without interacting several times. It is ok when inla crashes at some steps
and I have a NULL result there, thats not the main problem (although of course it would be best if inla always finishes.. ;-) ), but it takes very long time if I always have
to check if there is this crashing-window and then close it by hand...

Thanks,
Annette

I think this should work

        inla(..., silent = 2)

see ?inla and option 'silent'.

I already tried this option, but it does not help. Still this windows "information window" is appearing so that my loop cannot continue..
When I stop this information window, inla with silent=2 gives the following warnings (sorry that there is some german in it):

Warnmeldungen:
1: Ausführung von Kommando 'C:\windows\system32\cmd.exe /c @ "C:\Users\Anna\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmpiowcp0\file66416d166cc.BAT"' ergab Status 3
2: In shell(paste("@", shQuote(bat.file)), wait = TRUE) :
  '@ "C:\Users\Anna\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmpiowcp0\file66416d166cc.BAT"' execution failed with error code 3

When I do not set silent=2 but the default =1, there is an additonal warning:
3: In inla(formula, data = data.list, family = "normal", lincomb = lcs,  :
   *** The inla()-call return an error; please rerun with option verbose=TRUE.

and before all the warnings it tells me that GMRF lib has recieved error number 12 , reason is that the newton raphson optimizer does not converge.

(but my main concern at the moment is not the fact that inla does not give results in some cases but the problem with this annying windows 7 window)


But otherwiese there is no difference in the warnings or in the way everything behaves (loop hovers at that step and cannot continue unless I close this information window by hand).

Annette

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.exe is crashing, problems in windows 7
parts:
got it.

there are two options.

1. disable the popup-window in the OS, like


https://blogs.msdn.com/b/alejacma/archive/2011/02/18/how-to-disable-the-pop-up-that-windows-shows-when-an-app-crashes.aspx?Redirected=true


2. is to change the exit code for the inla-program when silent=2 (or
something else), so it does an 'exit(0)' and the we need to change the
collect.results routine so it does not break if there are no results to
get.


the error is usually there for a reason and making the model more robust
might help (less vague priors, say)

H
